craft_evidence.owned: claim only: the about page says Salomon "opened the Advanced Shoe Factory 4.0, a cutting-edge robotic production facility in France" in 2019 (current status not verified; not a clothing facility); Amer Sports 20-F FY2025 mentions group "owned manufacturing sites" and facilities in Austria, France and Germany without naming the brand; most group product comes from third-party suppliers (about 28% of sourced product made in the PRC)
craft_evidence.makers: no (no factory or maker named on any of the 53 men's clothing pages)
craft_evidence.mills: no (only the licensed GORE-TEX membrane is named, which counts as tech, not craft)
craft_evidence.madein: 0% (0 of 53 men's clothing PDPs state a country of origin in the page HTML)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed: "Founded in 1947 in Annecy, in the heart of the French Alps" by Georges Salomon (who-we-are page); the 20-F says products are conceived at the Annecy Design Center
craft_evidence.process: partial: technology pages describe membranes and footwear systems; no making process documented for clothing
craft_evidence.reasoning: Salomon's heritage is dated and placed (Annecy, 1947) and design is centred at its Annecy Design Center. Its own claim of an owned French robotic shoe factory covers footwear only and is unverified. None of the 53 men's clothing pages names a maker or mill or states a country of origin, so the clothing range is a 1-2 on the rubric; 2 is proposed on the strength of the documented heritage and design centre.

ownership.owner: Amer Sports, Inc. (NYSE: AS), listed; ANTA Sports is its largest shareholder (Form 20-F FY2025); Salomon revenue passed $2 billion in 2025 (+35%)
